title: Score list fit before touching copy: most of the list was the wrong investors
hypothesis: Low replies and Jonah's complaint about irrelevant emails were a copy problem.
change: Jev scored every lead's sector and stage fit from the portfolio evidence in the row, before any rewrite.
result: Qube: 10 sector fits, 28 weak, 443 no fit of 481 in audience. Vertocol 13 of 355, Ivy 59 of 214. No line of copy can make those emails relevant.
next_decision: Relaunch on FIT ONLY audiences (Qube 11, Vertocol 16, Ivy 35) and rebuild the lists, instead of rewriting copy for the whole list.
check: Before writing or rewriting any sequence, score the list's ICP fit and report fits over total. Under half fitting means fix the list first.
scope: Investor lists for early-stage companies, where fit is sector and stage. Held for all four Zeutara clients.
